name: Halla Pack Oy
why: Packaging plants run on volume, and every order still passes through several hands.
hint: Packaging and pallets for Finnish retailers.

ads.title: Tilauskäsittelijä
ads.quote: Päivität tilausvahvistukset asiakkaiden sähköposteista Exceliin ja siitä edelleen toiminnanohjausjärjestelmään.

ads.title: Logistics Coordinator
ads.quote: You will manually reconcile pallet counts between the warehouse system and carrier invoices every week.

ads.title: Talousassistentti
ads.quote: Kokoat kuukausiraportin kopioimalla luvut kolmesta eri järjestelmästä.

velhoCase.analystHint: The same order is typed into email, Excel and the ERP by different people.
fixOptions: Read order emails straight into the ERP
velhoCase.fixReasoning: Orders arrive by email and are retyped twice. Capturing them once at the source removes the Excel step and the errors that come with it.
velhoCase.adoptNote: Run it beside the order team for two weeks and let them approve every order until they trust it.

name: Routa Foods Oy
why: Food production needs shifts on the line, and planning still leans on spreadsheets.
hint: Bakery and ready meals sold in Finnish grocery stores.

ads.title: Laatuassistentti
ads.quote: Syötät tuotantoerien laatumittaukset paperilomakkeilta järjestelmään vuoron lopussa.

ads.title: Demand Planner
ads.quote: You will update the weekly sales forecast spreadsheet by hand from retailer reports.

ads.title: Myyntisihteeri
ads.quote: Hinnastomuutokset päivitetään manuaalisesti verkkokauppaan ja kassajärjestelmään.

velhoCase.analystHint: Three roles retype data from paper forms, retailer reports and price lists.
fixOptions: Digital quality forms on the line
One price list feeding every system
velhoCase.fixReasoning: The forecast drives production, purchasing and stock. Feeding retailer reports in automatically frees the planner's week and speeds up every decision downstream.
velhoCase.adoptNote: Keep the planner in charge: the model proposes, the planner adjusts and approves.

name: Kajo Steelworks Oy
why: Steel prices make revenue big, while quality paperwork still follows every delivery.
hint: Special steel bars for machine builders.

ads.title: Kunnossapitoteknikko
ads.quote: Kirjaat koneiden huoltotiedot vihkoon ja siirrät ne viikoittain huoltojärjestelmään.

ads.title: Quality Engineer
ads.quote: You will compile certificates for each delivery by copying test results into a Word template.

velhoCase.analystHint: Test results and maintenance logs are written by hand once, then copied again.
fixOptions: Move the maintenance log to tablets
velhoCase.fixReasoning: Every delivery waits for its certificate. Generating it straight from test results ships orders faster and removes copy errors that customers notice.
velhoCase.adoptNote: Start with one product line, show the quality engineers the hours saved, then roll it out.

name: Usva Retail Oy
why: Retail runs on people in stores, and head office stitches store data together.
hint: Home and garden stores across Finland.

ads.title: Controller
ads.quote: Tarkistat myymälöiden kassaerot vertaamalla raportteja Excelissä.

ads.title: Store Operations Assistant
ads.quote: You will manually update shelf price lists after every campaign change.

velhoCase.analystHint: Store data reaches head office by email and Excel, and is combined by hand.
fixOptions: Shift lists straight from a scheduling tool
velhoCase.fixReasoning: Till differences are checked store by store in Excel. Automatic matching flags only the real issues and frees the controller for analysis.
velhoCase.adoptNote: Send flagged differences to store managers in the tool they already use, not a new dashboard.

name: Kide Travel Oy
why: Travel sales are large, but every booking change still needs a person.

ads.title: Accounts Payable Specialist
ads.quote: You will manually match supplier invoices to bookings at month end.

ads.title: Asiakaspalvelija
ads.quote: Asiakkaiden muutospyynnöt kirjataan käsin kolmeen eri järjestelmään.

ads.title: Myyntiassistentti
ads.quote: Laadit tarjoukset kopioimalla hinnat toimittajien sivuilta Exceliin.

velhoCase.analystHint: Every booking change is typed into three separate systems.
fixOptions: One booking record that syncs everywhere
velhoCase.fixReasoning: A single change is retyped three times, so mistakes multiply. One booking record that syncs removes the retyping and makes invoice matching easy too.
velhoCase.adoptNote: Migrate one team's bookings first and keep the old screens read-only until everyone has switched.
